items.title: Seedream 5.0 Pro Image Editing
items.shortDescription: Seedream 5.0 Pro is grounded, region-precise image editing model that changes one element while keeping the rest of the frame intact with layer separation, sketch completion, and up to 10 reference images.
items.pricingInfoOverride: You will be charged for both input and output images. The first input image is not charged, and every additional input image will cost **$0.0045**.   Tentative pricing is **$0.0675+ $(0.0045 x number of additional input images)** per output image for images of total area less than or equal to **1536x1536** pixels. For output images with area in between **1536x1536** and **2048x2048** pixels, the price is **$0.135 + $(0.0045 x number of additional input images)** per image.

items.title: Seedream 5.0 Pro Layerize
items.shortDescription: Splits a finished image into independent, editable transparent-PNG layers — background plus separate elements, from a text description, returning 2 to 17 layers per call for non-destructive reuse in design tools.
items.pricingInfoOverride: Your request will cost **$0.03375 per generated layer** for total pixel area under 1536x1536. For total pixel area over 1536x1536, each request will cost **$0.0675 per generated layer** .  Please note that total pixel area is determined from the size of the generated base layer.

items.title: Seedream 5.0 Pro Text to Image
items.shortDescription: ByteDance's Seedream 5.0 Pro is flagship text-to-image model, with deep-thinking prompt understanding, native text in 14 languages, and precise control over dense layouts and structured designs.
items.pricingInfoOverride: Tentative pricing is **$0.0675** per image for images of total area less than or equal to **1536x1536** pixels. For images with area in between **1536x1536** and **2048x2048** pixels, the price is **$0.135** per image.
